text:
Maria K: Quick sync — I'm launching a small experiment on the pricing page today: hide the big token calculator by default, tighten the FAQ language around Dedicated vs Private, and test a new tier label. Thoughts? :wave:
Jon P: Sounds good. Which tier labels are you trying? 'Developer' / 'Team' / 'Enterprise'? or something more infra-y? :thinking_face:
Maria K: Trying 'Developer' for entry, 'Business' for committed, 'Dedicated' -> renamed to 'Reserved' in one variant. Want to see if less infra jargon improves signups. Also I want a one-line FAQ that explains Dedicated vs Private differences for security teams.
Lee (GTM): Love the simpler names. For the FAQ: keep it 1-2 sentences + link to compliance page. Eg: "Dedicated (Reserved) = single-tenant GPU pools with SLA; Private = customer-controlled VPC/on-prem with KMS and audit logs." Short and scannable.
Ashley: For calculator UX, can we prefill an example workload? People get lost with blanks. Prepopulate with "10 req/min, 1k tokens/req" and show monthly est.
Sam: Yep — also add a small note under the calc: "Estimates exclude caching & batching" so we don't undercut expectations.
Maria K: Good call. Jon, can you add the prefill + the small exclusion note? I can ship copy for the top-level hero and the FAQ.
Jon P: On it. One question on inbound lead routing: if someone clicks "Contact sales" from the Reserved/Dedicated variant, should it route to enterprise SDRs or regular growth queue?
Lee (GTM): Route Reserved->enterprise queue, Developer/Business->growth. We'll flag Reserved leads with "pricing:reserved-experiment" so SDRs can see A/B variant. gtm-bot: Created lead-routing ticket #4527 and added webhook to mark experiment tag.
Ashley: FYI for the webinar mention — we'll highlight the new calculator in the demo on Thursday. Maria, can you add a 1-liner in the registration confirmation email that links to the experimental pricing page?
Maria K: Yep — sample line: "Want to estimate costs before the demo? Try our new quick estimator on the pricing page." I'll drop that in the email draft.
Sam: Small nit: in the Dedicated vs Private FAQ draft, remove 'single-tenant' — ops folks sometimes interpret that as hardware isolation. Suggest: 'Dedicated/Reserved = isolated GPU pools under our management (SLA).'
Maria K: Good catch, Sam — I'll update. Anyone object if we run the test for two weeks and then evaluate funnel/SQLs and demo signups? :thumbsup:
Jon P: No objections. I'll instrument calc events: `calc_open`, `calc_submit`, `contact_from_reserved` and send to Amplitude.
Lee (GTM): Great — please include conversion by traffic source (organic vs paid) in the report.
Maria K: Thanks all. I'll push the FAQ copy, update the tier labels for variant B, and add the prefill to the calc. Will post results after 14 days.
